tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_bloodseeker_thirst_: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below %min_bonus_pct%%%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below %invis_threshold_pct%%%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.

Can be activated to grant bonus movement speed and %sanguivore_multiplier%x Sanguivore heal bonus for a short duration. While on cooldown, passive Thirst move speed is reduced by %inactive_penalty_pct%%% . Cannot be cast when all enemy heroes are at full health.
Strygwyr becomes frenzied when blood is spilled.
Max movement speed bonus occurs when an enemy's health is at or below %max_bonus_pct%%%.
Effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds if a target dies.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker_bio: Strygwyr the Bloodseeker is a ritually sanctioned hunter, Hound of the Flayed Twins, sent down from the mist-shrouded peaks of Xhacatocatl in search of blood. The Flayed Ones require oceanic amounts of blood to keep them sated and placated, and would soon drain their mountain empire of its populace if the priests of the high plateaus did not appease them. Strygwyr therefore goes out in search of carnage. The vital energy of any blood he lets, flows immediately to the Twins through the sacred markings on his weapons and armor. Over the years, he has come to embody the energy of a vicious hound; in battle he is savage as a jackal. Beneath the Mask of the Bloodseeker, in the rush of bloody quenching, it is said that you can sometime see the features of the Flayers taking direct possession of their Hound.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker_hype: Bloodseeker forces difficult decisions on his enemies. Able to drive his foes to a retreat by bathing a large area with a damaging ritual, his gruesome ultimate asks his opponents to hold still, or die.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker_npedesc1: Chases down low health enemies with increased speed

qualifications.raw:
* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Has an {{M|instant cast}} time regardless of its {{M|cast animation}}.

* The {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|bloodseeker_bloodrage}} has three main components:
** The buff consider {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}}, and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes.
** Reapplying the buff refreshes its duration, but does not update the ability values.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]]
*** Deals {{calc|v1/{{#var:Bloodrage basic1}} round2|v1={{#var:Bloodrage value1}}|%}} max {{M|health}} as self-damage in {{#var:Bloodrage basic1}}-second intervals, starting {{#var:Bloodrage basic1}} seconds upon the buff application, over {{#expr:trunc({{#var:Bloodrage value4}}/{{#var:Bloodrage basic1}})}} damage instances.
**** The buff duration ends {{#var:Bloodrage basic2}} seconds after the last self-damage instance.
**** Hence, Bloodrage has a total {{calc|v1/{{#var:Bloodrage basic1}}*trunc({{#var:Bloodrage value4}}/{{#var:Bloodrage basic1}}) round3|v1={{#var:Bloodrage value1}}|%}} max health cost over the entire duration.
**** The self-damage has the following properties:
***** Has the {{M|HP Removal}} flag and is non-lethal.
***** Does not proc {{M|on-damage effects}}.
***** Does not self-damage while the affected unit is {{M|invulnerable}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|3|21px]] {{Symbol|bonus shd}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** {{cf|shdnotes}} Bloodseeker's sucessful attack instance now applies bonus {{M|pure}} {{M|conditional attack damage}}.
**** The bonus attack damage values are directly added to the attacking unit's attack damage in the {{M|combat log}} and not displayed on the [[HUD]].
**** Does not interact with the following sources:
***** {{M|Allied units|x}}.
***** {{M|Buildings}}
***** {{M|Lifesteal}} and {{M|spell lifesteal}} sources.
***** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
***** Percentage-based {{M|bonus attack damage|x}} sources.
**** Interacts with the following sources:
***** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
****** {{M|Critical strike}} sources.
****** {{M|Cleave}} sources.
***** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
****** {{M|Debuff immune}} sources.

* The ability has three main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]]
*** All ability effects are granted and applied by an {{M|aura}}.
*** Considers {{M|clones}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes, {{M|illusions}} and other {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
**** Considers the following heroes as valid units:
***** {{M|Fogged}} units.
***** {{M|Invisible}} units.
***** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
***** {{M|Untargetable}} units.
**** Does not consider the following heroes as valid units:
***** {{M|Hidden}} units.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|bloodseeker_thirst}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Removes the {{G|movement speed max}} max {{M|movement speed}} cap for Bloodseeker upon learning the ability.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|3|21px]] {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{Symbol|Health}}
*** {{Symbol|Modifier|Stack}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|bloodseeker_thirst_speed}}
**** Grants the first stack ability bonuses when there are enemy heroes '''NOT''' at 100% max [[health]].
**** Grants the last stack ability bonuses when the affected enemy hero is below {{calc|v1+1%|v1={{#var:Thirst value3}}|%}} max health.
**** {{Symbol|a|Up}} {{Symbol|Movement Speed}}
***** Hence, the ability grants Bloodseeker 1% bonus [[movement speed]] per {{calc|({{#var:Thirst value2}}-{{#var:Thirst value3}})/v1*100 round4|v1={{#var:Thirst value4}}|%}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4l}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|({{#var:Thirst value2}}-{{#var:Thirst value3}})/v1*100 round4|v1={{#var:Thirst value4 tal}}|%}}|25tal}}) max health loss, per enemy hero.
**** {{Symbol|Vision|Base}}
***** {{M|Exposes}} and grants {{M|True Sight}} over the affected enemy.
**** {{Symbol|Dispel|Death}}
***** All ability bonuses are [[dispelled]] without the linger duration on Bloodseeker in the following conditions:
****** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Enemy Max[[Health|HP]] {{=}} 100% , buff disappears}}
****** Upon using {{M|buyback}}.
****** Upon {{M|Reincarnation}} sources proc.

* {{Symbol|Death}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** Grants Bloodseeker all ability bonuses at the max value even when the affected enemy hero [[dies]], regardless of the max health percentage they previously had.

* Sanguivore is an {{M|on-death effect}}.
** Considers {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
** The [[lifesteal]]-based restore value is defined as:
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|HealthRestore {{=}} {{#var:Sanguivore value1}} + ({{#var:Sanguivore value2}} × SelfLvl) × UnitMax[[Health|HP]])}}
** Has the following health restore functionalities:
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{Symbol|bonus ls}}
**** Applies a [[lifesteal]]-based heal to all kills credited to Bloodseeker, including the following sources:
***** {{M|Reincarnation}} sources.
**** Does not self-lifesteal when killing the following units:
***** {{M|The Double}}.
***** {{M|Forced kill}} sources.
***** {{M|Illusions}}
***** {{M|Buildings}}
***** All {{M|ward-type units}}.
***** {{M|Roshan}}
***** The {{M|Tormentor}}.
***** {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{A|Wraith King|Vampiric Spirit|text=Wraith Delay}}-affected units.
****** Other lifesteal-related ability effects are applied upon the Wraith Delay expiration.
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{Symbol|bonus hprestore}}
**** Applies a self-[[heal]] for kills credited to allied heroes within the enemy hero death heal radius, except the following sources:
***** From {{M|forced kill}} sources within the allied kill radius for the allied kill component.
Both [[Roshan]] and the [[Tormentor]] are innately immune to this ability.

**** {{Symbol|a|Up}} {{Symbol|Movement Speed}}
***** Hence, the ability grants Bloodseeker 1% bonus [[movement speed]] per {{calc|({{#var:Thirst value2}}-{{#var:Thirst value3}})/v1*100 round4|v1={{#var:Thirst value4}}|%}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4l}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|({{#var:Thirst value2}}-{{#var:Thirst value3}})/v1*100 round4|v1={{#var:Thirst value4 tal}}|%}}|25tal}}) max health loss, per enemy hero.
**** {{Symbol|Vision|Base}}
***** {{M|Exposes}} and grants {{M|True Sight}} over the affected enemy.
**** {{Symbol|Dispel|Death}}
***** All ability bonuses are [[dispelled]] without the linger duration on Bloodseeker in the following conditions:
****** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Enemy Max[[Health|HP]] {{=}} 100% , buff disappears}}
****** Upon using {{M|buyback}}.
****** Upon {{M|Reincarnation}} sources proc.

* {{Symbol|Death}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** Grants Bloodseeker all ability bonuses at the max value even when the affected enemy hero [[dies]], regardless of the max health percentage they previously had.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|bloodseeker_rupture}}
** Recasting the ability refreshes the debuff duration and applies the {{M|current health}} as spell damage again.
** Checks the moved distance of the affected unit in {{#var:Rupture basic1}}-second intervals, over {{calc|(v1/{{#var:Rupture basic1}})+1|v1={{#var:Rupture value4}}}} checks, upon debuff application.
*** Deals {{M|pure}} {{M|spell damage}} to the affected unit based on the distance moved or coordinate changes on the x-axis.
*** Does not apply the moved distance as damage on the {{M|combat log}} in the following conditions:
*** When the affected enemy unit is affected by {{M|invulnerable}} sources during the distance check interval.
**** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|NoDmgInstance , if ActualMovedDistance > {{#var:Rupture value3}}}}
**** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|NoDmgInstance , if NoMovedDistance on either the X-axis or Y-axis coordinates}}
*** Despite the ability sound effects, z-axis or {{M|upward movement}} sources do not count as moved distance, except {{A|Primal Beast|Pulverize}}.

* Affects the following units:
** {{M|Courier}}.
*** Applies the {{M|current health}} as damage but the applied debuff does nothing.

abilities: Rupture punishes mobile heroes — moving deals huge damage, so blinks and dashes backfire.
Spirit Vessel and Skadi cut the lifesteal Bloodseeker relies on to stay alive while diving.
items: Linken's Sphere blocks Bloodseeker's key single-target spell.
Silver Edge's Break shuts off Bloodseeker's passive abilities.
Spirit Vessel cuts Bloodseeker's healing and regeneration.
Lotus Orb reflects and dispels Bloodseeker's targeted disable.
Heaven's Halberd disarms melee Bloodseeker for several seconds.
Ghost Scepter makes you immune to Bloodseeker's physical attacks.

A chance to bash and stun in fights.
